top_signals.title: Trump-Tied Firm Boosts Bosnia Investment Plans to $2.3 Billion
top_signals.summary: A year-old US company with ties to President Donald Trump plans new projects in Bosnia-Herzegovina that would boost its investment in the country to just above €2 billion ($2.3 billion).

top_signals.title: Thieves Snatch $4 Million Diamond Necklace From Vienna Museum
top_signals.summary: A historic diamond necklace originally designed for the Egyptian royal family and valued at about $4 million was stolen from a major Vienna museum, triggering a police manhunt for the two alleged thieves.

top_signals.title: China’s Solar Boom Hits a Wall as Industry Losses Mount
top_signals.summary: Three of China’s top solar market players reported deepening losses over the first half of the year, reflecting weakening demand for solar in the world’s top manufacturer and generator. Jinko Solar, JA Solar Technology, and Tongwei all reported six-month losses as overcapacity in the sector meets weakening demand, not only at home but also abroad, Bloomberg reported, citing statements made by the companies at their financial results releases.
